name: Irish Championship 2017
information: This competition is open to everyone, but only Irish competitors will be eligible for prizes. There will be a 100 person competitor limit. You can reserve a spot by registering on this page and paying the registration fee online [here](http://www.ukca.org/irish-championship-2017-payment) before June 12th (now unavailable). If 100 competitors pay, registration will be considered full and those who have not paid will stay on the waiting list unless someone drops out. If we do not reach 100 paid competitors, registration at the door will still be possible.
